# Implementation Plan: Modern Responsive To-Do Web Application

## Goal Description
Build a feature-rich, modern, mobile-first To-Do web application in the repository [Ruazo84/create-a-to-do-app](file:///home/agent/workspace). The app will be accessible immediately via the live preview link ([https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/d8e53449-14a3-4b8e-86a1-d885c73c980d/c25b454e5c6465e64f9eeb32/](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/d8e53449-14a3-4b8e-86a1-d885c73c980d/c25b454e5c6465e64f9eeb32/)) and will run seamlessly on mobile (iOS/Android) and desktop browsers.

## User Review Required
> [!NOTE]
> **Google Sign-In Status**: Your Google account (`3designmax777@gmail.com`) is already successfully connected. The authorization code string you sent (`4/0AUn6...`) has fulfilled its purpose and no further login actions are required.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Architecture Decision**: The application will be created as a responsive, zero-build client-side web application (HTML5, Tailwind CSS via CDN, Lucide Icons, and Vanilla JavaScript). This ensures instant loading in the web preview without requiring Node/server hosting. All tasks are persisted locally in `localStorage`.

## Open Questions
> [!NOTE]
> Please let us know if you'd like to adjust any of the following initial defaults:
> 1. **Default Categories**: The default categories will be `Personal`, `Work`, `Study`, and `Shopping`. Would you like custom category creation enabled?
> 2. **Initial Sample Data**: Should the app load with 3 pre-populated helpful tasks on first open (e.g., "Welcome to your new To-Do app!"), or start completely empty?

## Proposed Changes

```mermaid
graph TD
    UI["index.html (Semantic UI + Tailwind)"] --> App["js/app.js (Core Logic)"]
    App --> Storage["localStorage (Persistence)"]
    App --> DOM["DOM Renderer (Tasks, Badges, Stats)"]
    App --> Theme["Theme Manager (Dark / Light Mode)"]
    App --> Filters["Filter & Search Controller"]
    Style["css/styles.css (Animations & Custom Styles)"] --> UI
```

---

### Core Web Application

#### [NEW] [index.html](file:///home/agent/workspace/index.html)
- Semantic HTML5 structure optimized for mobile viewports (iOS safe areas, touch targets ≥44px).
- Header with live date display, task completion progress bar, and theme toggle (dark/light).
- Input bar to quickly add tasks with title, category selector, priority level (Low / Medium / High), and optional due date.
- Search and filter bar:
  - Search input with real-time filtering
  - Status tabs: **All**, **Active**, **Completed**
  - Category filters and Priority filters
  - Sort dropdown (Date Created, Due Date, Priority)
- Task list container with empty state illustration and animated task cards.
- Quick actions: clear completed, export/import JSON data, and batch completion.

#### [NEW] [css/styles.css](file:///home/agent/workspace/css/styles.css)
- Custom styles for smooth slide-in/fade-out item transitions.
- Checkbox micro-animations and strike-through text effects.
- Priority color-coded badges and glowing accents.
- Responsive mobile enhancements and custom scrollbars.

#### [NEW] [js/app.js](file:///home/agent/workspace/js/app.js)
- Task Model: `{ id, title, completed, priority, category, dueDate, createdAt }`.
- `StorageManager`: Handles JSON serialization, retrieval, and error resilience with `localStorage`.
- `TaskManager`: Handles CRUD operations (Add, Toggle, Edit inline, Delete).
- `FilterManager`: Multi-parameter filtering (status, text query, category, priority) and sorting.
- `ThemeManager`: Dark/Light theme switching with persistence and system `prefers-color-scheme` support.
- `StatsManager`: Calculates real-time completion percentage and counts.

#### [NEW] [README.md](file:///home/agent/workspace/README.md)
- Project overview, list of features, and instructions for viewing in mobile and desktop browsers.

---

## Verification Plan

### Automated Tests
- Syntax validation using Node.js:
  ```bash
  node -c js/app.js
  ```
- Headless browser verification or HTML validation:
  ```bash
  node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const html = fs.readFileSync("index.html", "utf8"); if (!html.includes("<!DOCTYPE html>")) process.exit(1);'
  ```

### Manual Verification
1. Open the preview link: [https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/d8e53449-14a3-4b8e-86a1-d885c73c980d/c25b454e5c6465e64f9eeb32/](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/d8e53449-14a3-4b8e-86a1-d885c73c980d/c25b454e5c6465e64f9eeb32/)
2. Add several tasks with different priorities, categories, and due dates.
3. Test checking off tasks and verifying the progress counter updates.
4. Test search and filtering by status, category, and priority.
5. Toggle between Dark and Light mode.
6. Refresh the page to verify that data persists across sessions.
